notes: 🖨 The portfolio now prints like a real statement. Both print buttons produce it: an account summary up top (value, cash, reserved, open P/L, day change, fees paid, starting balance, total return), holdings with each share’s day move, exit plan and note, pending orders with their reserved cash and expiry, then the 12-month trade history — landscape, page-break aware, no app buttons on paper. Previously the top print button copied the interactive cards, buttons and all, and the statement skipped the account summary and pending orders entirely.
